title: Netherlands, Germany – Industry specific software development services – Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program (Dynamic Purchasing System - EU-404)
description: Welcome to the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program and adjacent subjects. Note: This Dynamic Purchasing System is a continuation on the Mercell platform of the DPS that was previously operational on the Negometrix platform with Negometrix reference 159478 for which formal notice 2021/S 087-226573 was published on 5-May-2021 on the TED website. If your company was already qualified for participation on the Negometrix platform, a simplified procedure applies for re-establishing your qualification, see question 2.1 on the Mercell platform. TenneT will renew and innovate the (IT) systems that it uses for controlling and balancing its grids in the period 2021-2031. In connection with this, TenneT expects to be needing extensive external expertise, related to existing and new technologies and ways of working, in particular related to the challenges that TenneT faces in the energy transition. Compared to current ways of working, innovations will be needed to handle e.g. the increasing infeed of solar and wind energy that is far more difficult to predict and control than traditional generation. The subject of this tender procedure is a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for expertise (including the development of algorithms and IT Tools) that TenneT needs in connection with the renewal of its (IT) systems related to the control and balancing of the electricity transmission grid. Initially, the DPS contains the following categories of expertise: 1. power system control and monitoring; 2. energy platforms and interconnected IT systems; 3. data analysis, artificial intelligence and machine learning; 4. system and process implementation. This Tender Dossier contains the rules for the Application by Economic operators for qualification under this DPS. In order to become qualified for one or more of the categories, the Economic operator has to fulfil all the requirements of this DPS. In addition, the Economic operator needs to the answer all Mercell questions, and submit the requested documents and-or evidence at the respective Mercell question with the submission of its Application. During the course of time, the specific assignments (contracts) under the DPS will be tendered for which all suppliers that have qualified for the particular category will be invited to submit an offer. Any interested supplier may at any moment during the lifetime of the DPS submit a request to be qualified for participating in the tender procedures for specific assignments within one or more of the categories of this DPS. Your request will be accepted if it satisfies the applicable requirements and if you accept the stated conditions. Once you have qualified, you will automatically receive a notification when TenneT publishes a request for proposal for a specific subject within a category for which you have qualified. TenneT emphasises that it would also like to attract small and medium sized companies to this DPS. Qualification requests will be processed by TenneT in the sequence of receipt. TenneT will inform you as soon as possible and endeavors to do so within 10 working days from the date of receipt about the acceptance or rejection of your qualification request. During the lifetime of the DPS, TenneT will be entitled to add new categories, to close existing categories, and to split-up existing categories in to one or more categories.

title: FMC Butner Precast Joint Replacement
description: This is a Sources Sought Notice. This notice is issued for market research purposes only. This is not a solicitation or invitation for firms to submit qualification documents or proposals. Should this requirement move forward, a combined synopsis/solicitation of the proposed contract action will be posted at a later date providing instructions for firms to respond to this opportunity. Please only respond to this Sources Sought Notice if you are seriously interested and if your company is capable of performing the corresponding work required. The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) anticipates the issuance of a solicitation for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project titled Precast Joint Replacement at the Federal Medical Center (FMC) Butner located at Old NC Highway 75, Butner NC 27509. A summary of the requirement is as follows: The Contractor shall perform the prescribed work on the exterior precast concrete panel control joints, concrete to metal window frame joints, louvers, and doors on all elevations of the FMC Butner buildings, as well as designated expansion joints. All joints shall be cut out, cleaned, primed, fitted with appropriately sized backer rod, and caulked using polyurethane sealant. Polyurethane sealant/caulking must meet ASTM Standards C920 and C1193. Expansion joints shall be replaced with baffled gaskets that meet or exceed the specifications of the existing expansion joints. (See controlled document(s)) Access to controlled documents will require an active vendor registration at SAM.gov as well as your Marketing Partner Identification Number (MPIN) associated with your SAM registration. You will need to request access to the controlled document(s) and receive approval prior to being able to view the files. The controlled documents will not be emailed. If you encounter problems requesting access to these documents, please refer to the Help section on SAM.gov or contact the Federal Service Desk at 866-606-8220. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code applicable to this requirement is 238120 � Structural Steel and Precast Contractors with a corresponding small business size standard of $19.0 million, The FBOP is seeking small business contractors for this project. Interested firms are requested to respond to this notice by completing and emailing the completed questionnaire to Mike Miller at mmiller2@bop.gov. Responses must be received no later than October 6, 2026. Interested small business contractors are requested to respond to this notice by adding their names to the Interested Vendors List for this posting on the SAM website at https://sam.gov. You must be logged in to your vendor account in order to access the Interested Vendors List. Please add your business name only if you are interested in submitting a quote as a Prime contractor and are capable and eligible to compete for and perform this project. This notice is intended only for those who would be entering into a Prime contract with FBOP for the entirety of the project. The FBOP does not award subcontracts. Subcontracts (if applicable/necessary) are the responsibility of the Prime contractor. The FBOP has no privity of contract with subcontractors. The combined synopsis/solicitation of the proposed contract action will include further instructions for responding to this opportunity. Interested firms are advised to continuously monitor Sam.gov for all future updates.

title: Fitness Center O&M Sources Sought
description: PLEASE SUBMIT ALL RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT TO JAMIE MELZER-COMPTON AT JLMELZER@FBI.GOV BY TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026, AT 10:00 AM ET. Introduction This notice is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for proposal or quote. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the government. Responses in any form are not offers and the government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary. Background The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Sources Sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for establishing, managing, and operating Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services. The Government expects the Contractor to operate the Fitness Center at FBI Redstone to include on-site fitness center coordination, program coordinator, certified personal trainer, equipment maintenance and repair staff, fitness center management staff and ensure a complete, effective, well-balanced, exercise and equipment maintenance program. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 713940. The total period of performance for this contract, to include all options, shall not exceed five (5) calendar years. Contractor Qualifications If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: Firm Information: Organization name (Legal/DBA), Address, Point of Contact (POC), E-mail address, Website address, Telephone number, UEI Number Cage Code, Facility Clearance (if applicable), GSA Schedule (if applicable), and Size and type of ownership for the organization A brief description of at least two (2), but no more than three (3), Fitness Center O&M services similar to the requirements described within the Background Section above. The prior services provided shall be within the past five (5) years. Minimum information should include the following: contract number, total contract value, project location, period of performance, and a brief description of the services. Provide a general statement of your qualifications, capabilities, and ability to perform the required types of work described. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. Information and suggestions that may encourage new, different, or innovative approaches that would result in products, solutions, and direct savings to the FBI. Contemplated Requirement The FBI is issuing this Sources Sought to: Gather industry information on Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services at FBI Redstone. Request information on any industry changes or improvements that the FBI should consider when looking to achieve products and capabilities that meet requirements and are compatible with the commercial environment. Request information on potential barriers to obtaining solutions that meet objectives needed to accomplish stated requirements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: Provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated. Secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements. Implement a successful project management plan that includes compliance with program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of key personnel and risk mitigation. Provide services under a performance-based service acquisition contract. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by Tuesday, October 13, 2026 by 10:00 AM ET to JLMELZER@fbi.gov. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice/market research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses or procured through full and open competition, and multiple awards may be made. Responses shall not include: Proposals or Offers. Requests to be considered for award or to be notified of a future solicitation. Requests to be added to a mailing list or distribution list. Questions or comments not related to this Sources Sought. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. title: France – Advertising and marketing services – Prestations de communication numérique touristique et d'attractivité-.
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la structuration et la planification d’une communication numérique dédiée à la promotion des atouts touristiques de Troyes Champagne Métropole. Cette stratégie doit reposer principalement sur un vécu expérientiel dans lequel les prospects et repeaters (visiteurs récurrents) vont se projeter et s’identifier. Pour ce faire, les prestations attendues au titre de ce marché reposent sur une stratégie de promotion numérique sur Internet et les réseaux sociaux (dont ceux de l’Office du tourisme, de la ville de Troyes et de Troyes Champagne Métropole) et pouvant être déclinés en spots télévisés segmentés et replay. Conformément à l’article L2113-10 du Code de la commande publique, la présente consultation est allotie comme suit : Lot n°1 : Création et mise au format de visuels publicitaires ; Lot n°2 : Réalisation de vidéos et prise de photos ; Lot n°3 : Média planning et stratégie de diffusion numérique ; En application de l’article R2113-1 du Code de la commande publique, les opérateurs économiques peuvent soumissionner pour les 3 lots. Les 3 lots susvisés peuvent être attribués à un seul et même opérateur économique. Conformément aux dispositions des articles L2125-1.1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6 et R. 2162-13 à R. 2162-14 du Code de la Commande Publique, chaque lot donnera lieu, à la conclusion d’un accord-cadre mono-attributaire à bons de commande. Le titulaire de l’accord-cadre sera consulté, à chaque survenance d’un besoin, par le biais de l’émission de bons de commande, conformément aux dispositions des articles R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la Commande Publique. En application de l’article R.2162-4-2° du Code de la Commande Publique, l’accord-cadre sera conclu avec les montants maximum suivants : - S’agissant du lot n°1 : un montant maximum de 40 000 € HT annuel ; - S’agissant du lot n°2 : un montant maximum de 60 000 € HT annuel ; - S’agissant du lot n°3 : un montant maximum de 80 000 € HT annuel. Pour chaque lot, la durée de validité du présent marché court à compter de sa date de notification pour une durée d’un an. Celui-ci est reconductible, 3 fois par voie tacite, par période de 12 mois. Le titulaire du marché public ne pourra refuser la reconduction conformément aux dispositions de l’article R2112-4 du Code de la commande publique. En cas de non-reconduction, un courrier sera adressé au(x) titulaire(s) du marché public au moins un mois avant l’échéance de ce dernier. Pour chaque lot, les délais d’exécution seront fixés au sein de chaque bon de commande.

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. title: France – Graphic design services – Réalisation de schéma synoptiques des installations de la Direction du système d'Assainissement et du Réseau : période 2026-2030
description: Les besoins en synoptiques pour la DSAR: Le développement d'une représentation standardisée des stations locales (noeuds de gestion, stations de pompage ou de prétraitement) présente de multiples intérêts : -Faciliter la compréhension du fonctionnement des sites pour les nouveaux arrivants -Faciliter les échanges entre agents de terrain et de bureau -Limiter les risques de confusion lors de la programmation des interventions dans les réseaux -Faciliter le travail avec des intervenants extérieurs ne connaissant pas les installations Concrètement, les synoptiques répondront à plusieurs usages et notamment : -Fournir une représentation unique de chaque ouvrage, qui sera utilisée à la fois comme fond de vue Supervision, et dans les Fiches de Fonctionnement, documents en cours d'élaboration qui définiront, pour chaque station locale, son mode de fonctionnement dans toutes les situations (temps sec/ de pluie, basses eaux/ crue, mode normal/ dégradé ...) -Fournir un support de formation, pour les régulateurs du PC SAPHYRS ou d'autres agents DSAR, ou d'autres Directions -Repérage sur site à l'aide de supports placardés localement, ou réalisation de classeurs qui seront mis à disposition des agents de terrain dans les véhicules d'intervention -Illustration dans les documents et notes élaborées par la DSAR Différents types de synoptiques Différents types de synoptiques seront nécessaires pour chaque ouvrage, en fonction de sa complexité, de sa criticité, et des spécificités qu'il présente : -Synoptique 2D très simplifié pour une compréhension immédiate et globale du fonctionnement -Synoptique 2D plus élaboré pour rentrer dans certains détails -Synoptique 3D &quot; statique &quot; : des vues 3D figées sous des angles pertinents pédagogiquement -Maquette 3D : fichier informatique qui permet de regarder l'ouvrage sous différents angles, de générer des vues (coupes, plans ...) selon ses besoins -Synoptique animé : sur une vue 2D ou 3D, représentation symbolique et dynamique des écoulements pour faciliter la compréhension des ouvrages les plus complexes. Un rendu homogène L'homogénéité des rendus est importante, pour assurer une bonne compréhension de tous les intervenants, sur les Unités d'Intervention Est et Ouest, mais également en Central, pour les agents du PC SAPHYRS, de l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement, ou pour des partenaires d'autres Directions comme la Direction Technique, dont les projets sont souvent interfacés avec la DSAR. Ainsi, tous les synoptiques d'un même type (2D simplifié, 3D etc.) seront être homogènes pour tous les ouvrages représentés. Et pour chaque ouvrage, la cohérence sera cruciale entre les différents synoptiques qui apportent différents niveaux de compréhension et de détail. Le pilotage du projet Synoptiques sera assuré par l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement du Service Exploitation et Maintenance de la DSAR. Le premier marché a permis d'établir la charte graphique commune à tous les synoptiques, et de réaliser les premiers synoptiques. Le travail doit se poursuivre pour traiter tous les sites de la DSAR nécessitant une représentation graphique

title: France – Graphic design services – Réalisation de schéma synoptiques des installations de la Direction du système d'Assainissement et du Réseau : période 2026-2030
description: Les besoins en synoptiques pour la DSAR: Le développement d'une représentation standardisée des stations locales (noeuds de gestion, stations de pompage ou de prétraitement) présente de multiples intérêts : -Faciliter la compréhension du fonctionnement des sites pour les nouveaux arrivants -Faciliter les échanges entre agents de terrain et de bureau -Limiter les risques de confusion lors de la programmation des interventions dans les réseaux -Faciliter le travail avec des intervenants extérieurs ne connaissant pas les installations Concrètement, les synoptiques répondront à plusieurs usages et notamment : -Fournir une représentation unique de chaque ouvrage, qui sera utilisée à la fois comme fond de vue Supervision, et dans les Fiches de Fonctionnement, documents en cours d'élaboration qui définiront, pour chaque station locale, son mode de fonctionnement dans toutes les situations (temps sec/ de pluie, basses eaux/ crue, mode normal/ dégradé ...) -Fournir un support de formation, pour les régulateurs du PC SAPHYRS ou d'autres agents DSAR, ou d'autres Directions -Repérage sur site à l'aide de supports placardés localement, ou réalisation de classeurs qui seront mis à disposition des agents de terrain dans les véhicules d'intervention -Illustration dans les documents et notes élaborées par la DSAR Différents types de synoptiques Différents types de synoptiques seront nécessaires pour chaque ouvrage, en fonction de sa complexité, de sa criticité, et des spécificités qu'il présente : -Synoptique 2D très simplifié pour une compréhension immédiate et globale du fonctionnement -Synoptique 2D plus élaboré pour rentrer dans certains détails -Synoptique 3D &quot; statique &quot; : des vues 3D figées sous des angles pertinents pédagogiquement -Maquette 3D : fichier informatique qui permet de regarder l'ouvrage sous différents angles, de générer des vues (coupes, plans ...) selon ses besoins -Synoptique animé : sur une vue 2D ou 3D, représentation symbolique et dynamique des écoulements pour faciliter la compréhension des ouvrages les plus complexes. Un rendu homogène L'homogénéité des rendus est importante, pour assurer une bonne compréhension de tous les intervenants, sur les Unités d'Intervention Est et Ouest, mais également en Central, pour les agents du PC SAPHYRS, de l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement, ou pour des partenaires d'autres Directions comme la Direction Technique, dont les projets sont souvent interfacés avec la DSAR. Ainsi, tous les synoptiques d'un même type (2D simplifié, 3D etc.) seront être homogènes pour tous les ouvrages représentés. Et pour chaque ouvrage, la cohérence sera cruciale entre les différents synoptiques qui apportent différents niveaux de compréhension et de détail. Le pilotage du projet Synoptiques sera assuré par l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement du Service Exploitation et Maintenance de la DSAR. Le premier marché a permis d'établir la charte graphique commune à tous les synoptiques, et de réaliser les premiers synoptiques. Le travail doit se poursuivre pour traiter tous les sites de la DSAR nécessitant une représentation graphique

Уведомяване на Възложителя за липсващи реквизити,съобразно изискванията на НАЦИД за кандидат – студенти от държави извън Европейския съюз и Европейското икономическо пространство, преди стартиране на следващия етап от процедурата​​​​​​​; Дейност 2: Официален превод от китайски, английски език, както при необходимост и от други езици, на образователни документи (диплома за завършено средно образование, придобито в училище на чужда държава и приложения към нея; документи, удостоверяващи, че документът за завършено средно образование дава право за обучение във висши училища; други образователни документи) на български език;Преводите трябва да бъдат извършени от заклети преводачи, вписани в съответните регистри на Министерството на Външните работи или от преводач, чиито подпис е удостоверен пред нотариус съгласно чл. 21а от Правилник за легализациите, заверките и преводите на документи и други книжа (ПЛЗПДДК). Дейност 3: Дейност по легализация и заверка —Организация на нотариална заверка на подписа на преводача в Република България и оформяне на документите съгласно изискванията на Националния център за информация и документация (НАЦИД). Изпълнителят извършва финално окомплектоване на документите съгласно изискванията на НАЦИД, включително дигитализиране (сканиране с висока резолюция) и изготвяне на проекти на необходимите заявления и пълномощни за представителство пред НАЦИД. Дейност 4: Административно съдействие пред НАЦИД - Подготовка на пълния комплект документи, попълване на заявления, комплектоване, подаване (по електронен път с КЕП или на място) и представителство пред Националния център за информация и документация (НАЦИД) до финалното произнасяне с решение за признаване на образователната степен - административно съдействие при подаване и проследяване на документи пред НАЦИД; съдействие при получаване на удостоверение за признато средно образование и служебна бележка за приравняване на оценки; Дейността се счита за приключила с получаването на финалния административен акт от компетентния орган (Удостоверение за признаване, служебна бележка или Решение за отказ) и физическото му предаване на Възложителя с приемо-предавателен протокол в срок до 3 (три) работни дни , считано от датата на неговото издаване. Дейност 5: Допълнителни дейности, включени в предмета на поръчката: комуникация с кандидати и/или служители на УНСС, при необходимост от допълване на документи; Финално депозиране на целият пакет документи (финализирана преписка) в Дирекция „Международна дейност" в УНСС - в срок до 3 (три) работни дни. Услугите ще бъдат извършвани по заявка от страна на Възложителя, като прогнозното количество на преписките от документи, издадени от образователни институции на чуждестранни граждани от държави извън Европейския съюз и Европейското икономическо пространство, за целия период на действие на договора е 960 (деветстотин и шестдесет). Индикативен годишен брой преписки, които ще бъдат обработвани - 240 (двеста и четиридесет) на година. Така определеното прогнозно количество, няма обвързващ характер по отношение на Възложителя, като броя на заявените преписки може да варира, както на годишна основа, така и за целия период на договора. description: Procedura de atribuire implică încheierea unui contract de prestare „Servicii de închiriere spaţii de depozitare și servicii conexe”, în conf cu prevederile Caietului de sarcini nr. 87263/05.08.2026. Clauză suspensivă: “Procedura de atribuire a contractului de achiziție publică având ca obiect servicii logistice de depozitare se derulează sub incidența prezentei clauze suspensive, în sensul că încheierea contr este condiționată de asigurarea și alocarea fondurilor bugetare aferente contrde finanțare pentru grantul”UCPM Logistical Hub for Ukraine UARO2-bis-UCPM hub”. În consecință, contr de achiziție publică nu va fi încheiat anterior îndeplinirii condiției suspensive, respectiv anterior asigurării fondurilor necesare pentru finanțarea serviciilor care fac obiectul achiziției. În cazul în care, indiferent de motive, în termen de 45 zile de la data aprobării raportului procedurii, nu este alocat bugetul aferent contr de finanțare a grantului ”UARO2-bis-UCPM hub” procedura de atribuire se va anula de drept, în conformitate cu prevederile art. 212 alin.(1) lit.c) teza 2 din Legea 98/2016, fiind imposibilă încheierea contr de achiziție publică. Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri înțeleg că AC nu poate fi considerată răspunzătoare pentru vreun prejudiciu în cazul anulării procedurii de atribuire, indiferent de natura acestuia și indiferent dacă AC fost notificată asupra existenței unui asemenea prejudiciu. Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri acceptă utilizarea condițiilor speciale de mai sus/clauzei suspensive, asumându-și întreaga răspundere în raport cu eventualele prejudicii pe care le-ar putea suferi în situația descrisă.” Clauză de revizuire: Procedura de atribuire a contractelor de achiziție publică este inițiată sub incidența clauzei de revizuire. În temeiul art. 221 alin. (1) litera a) din Legea nr. 98/2016, AC utilizează în cadrul prezentei procedurii de achiziție clauza de revizuire privind opțiunea de suplimentare a perioadei contractuale inițiale. Mai exact, în situația identificării unei/unor surse de finanțare, autoritatea contractantă poate prelungi perioada de valabilitate a contractului cu maxim 60 luni, suplimentar perioadei inițiale. Valoarea totală estimată a achiziției a fost stabilită cu includerea opțiunii de suplimentare. Având în vedere modalitatea de aplicare a clauzei de revizuire, propunerea financiară va fi formulată pentru perioada certă pe care AC se poate angaja contractual, respectiv 12 luni (365 zile). Pentru prelungirea perioadei de valabilitate a contractului, în situația identificării unei/unor surse de finanțare, urmează să se încheie un act adițional la contractul inițial, în conformitate cu prevederile art. 221 din Legea nr. 98/2016, și ale Instrucțiunii Președintelui ANAP nr. 1 /2021. În situația în care, prin aplicarea clauzei de rev ref la opțiunea de suplimentare a perioadei contractuale inițiale, perioada de valabilitate a contractului va depăși 24 luni, prețul unitar va fi ajustat astfel: începând cu prima zi de la împlinirea celor 24 luni de la semnarea contr, pentru determinarea prețului unitar în lei a serviciilor, inclusiv serviciile conexe, ce va fi utilizat pentru stabilirea valorii contr, se va utiliza următoarea formulă de ajustare, respectiv: PUa= (PUi * IPC)/100 PUa– repr prețul unitar ajustat; PUi-repr prețul unitar inițial; IPC – reprezintă indicele prețului de consum anual comunicat de INS pentru anul anterior celui în care se dorește încheierea contr (https://insse.ro/cms/ro/content/ipc%E2%80%93serie-de-date-anuala). În situația în care nu este publicat, se utilizează indicele din anul anterior. Det valorii finale a contr se rerealizează după depunerea ultimei facturi de către contractant, în baza situației centralizatoare a plăților, ce va cuprinde totalitatea cheltuielilor efectuate în baza contri, inclusiv în baza actelor adiționale la acesta, însușită de contractant și aprobată de Autoritatea contractantă, prin încheierea unui act adițional la contract.

title: Norway – Software supply services – Platform for the administration and distribution of digital teaching aids and learning tools.
description: Background and purpose Arendal is located in the central part of Sørlandet. The municipality has approx. 46,000 inhabitants. Arendal municipality has a decentralised school structure with 16 municipal primary and secondary schools, organised as independent entities with separate rectors and management groups. The schools include both combined 1st - 10th schools and pure primary schools (1st - 7th years), as well as a resource centre with tenders across the stages. The municipality has a total of approx. 5,000 pupils in the primary and lower secondary schools. Arendal municipality is in an ongoing change of the school structure. Two primary schools (1st – 7th years) and the secondary school for one school have been decided to be folded. The changes are planned to be implemented from 01.01.2027. The overall responsibility for the school area is at the school office, which follows up on joint priorities, quality work and regulations, and acts as a link between the political level and the schools. The cooperation between the school office and the schools will take place, among other things, through fixed meeting points and joint development work, at the same time that each school adapts the work to local needs. The adult education is organised as a part of the municipality ́s training and is also a user of relevant digital services. Arendal municipality needs a joint system for the administration, distribution and access management of digital teaching aids in primary and secondary schools. The municipality has used a system for this purpose over time and has developed good experience with procurement, licence management and access management in this area. The procurement will be carried out as a result of the expiry of the existing agreement and shall ensure the continuation and further development of this work. Information on the procurement and process is in the document Konkurransegrunnlag_Digital Platform for schools. Scope The estimated annual scope is challenging to estimate. This is connected with the complexity, changes in the school structure and a market with different actors. We estimate that the annual turnover will be NOK 3.0 million excluding VAT, which over 8 years will be NOK 24 million excluding VAT. The contract will have a valid amount of NOK 30 million excluding VAT during the contract period. The estimated scope is based on experiences with the current supplier, market dialogue and indicative prices in the market. The estimated scope is not binding for the contracting authority. The following is not included in this procurement: - Learning platform (LMS) and educational follow-up. - functionality connected to artificial intelligence (KI) - other school administrative systems. The procurement is for the administration and distribution of digital teaching aids and a learning tool. Handling printed teaching aids is not included. The procurement does not include discipline specific teaching aids or individual applications. Reservations All conditions that the tenderer has for the tender shall be stated in the point conditions in the requirement specification document. Alternative tenders Alternative tenders cannot be submitted. Documents Please see the attached documents. Note that the tenderer shall fill in information in the attached documents.

title: Norway – Graphic design services – Graphic services
description: Background Arendal municipality has an ongoing need for graphical services connected to information material and visual communication aimed at inhabitants and internal target groups. The municipality produces some material itself, but needs external assistance for assignments that are more complex, time consuming or require special professional competence. The procurement shall ensure access to capacity and relevant competence within graphical design, at the same time as the municipality takes care of the need for uniform visual communication and clear identity. The municipality shall be one sender. It is also important to ensure that material and visual deliveries fulfil the requirements for universal design and ensure accessible and understandable communication for different user groups. The municipality therefore needs to establish a new framework agreement that provides predictable access to graphical assistance as needed, both for smaller ongoing assignments and for major or more strategic deliveries. Description of the assignment The procurement is for graphic services for Arendal municipality. The delivery shall cover the development and production of various types of graphical material and visual elements, including information material, reports, presentations, templates, graphics for digital surfaces, infographics, illustrations and professional design consultancy services. The assignments will vary in extent and complexity. The municipality needs a tenderer who can assist with both smaller, limited assignments and large deliveries that require more planning and close cooperation with the contracting authority. Minor assignments means limited deliveries such as, for example, an ad, poster, presentation or simple illustration. Larger deliveries means assignments that include planning, coordination and multiple sub-services, such as a report or campaign material. The deliveries shall be able to be used further in the municipality ́s own channels and tools, and it is important that the deliveries can be further developed and adapted internally. The framework agreement shall also include the design of profile material and profile articles, as well as graphic materials connected to the use of, among other things, vehicles, buildings and work clothes. Web design for arendal.kommune.no is not included in the procurement. It is important to have clear contact points, effective clarifications and a good understanding of the municipality ́s graphical profile, communication needs and targets for clear, available and recognisable communication.

title: Netherlands – Postal services – Postdienstverlening
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Scope van de opdracht De opdracht omvat de integrale postdienstverlening voor de gemeente Breda, waaronder in ieder geval: het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van geadresseerde poststukken; het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van pakketten; het verwerken en bezorgen van verkiezingspost; het verwerken van retourzendingen; Haalservice (postbus)post en Brengservcie (postbus)post; het verzorgen van aangetekende poststukken (Binnenland en Buitenland) en overige bijzondere postdiensten; het verzorgen van kwaliteitsborging en prestatiemonitoring. De exacte omvang en inhoud van de dienstverlening zijn nader uitgewerkt in het Programma van Eisen en de SLA. Buiten de scope valt: verspreiding huis aan huis berichten (gemeentelijke berichten) en fietskoersdiensten. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één contractpartij voor het verzorgen van de postdienstverlening ten behoeve van gemeente Breda. Deze raamovereenkomst zal worden aangegaan voor een periode van 2 jaar. De ingangsdatum van deze raamovereenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze raamovereenkomst tegen dezelfde voorwaarden en condities twee (2) maal te verlengen, telkens voor de duur van één (1) jaar. De maximale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst bedraagt derhalve vier (4) jaar. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestaties van de dienstverlening. Gunning en motivatie De aanbestedende dienst gunt de opdracht aan de inschrijver op basis van het gunningscriterium laagste prijs, omdat de gevraagde dienstverlening volledig, objectief en eenduidig is gespecificeerd in het Programma van Eisen, de Service Level Agreement (SLA) en de raamovereenkomst. De vereiste kwaliteit van de dienstverlening is volledig vastgelegd in minimumeisen, prestatie-eisen, KPI's en contractvoorwaarden ten aanzien van onder meer bezorgkwaliteit, bestelkwaliteit, verkiezingspost, klachtenafhandeling, managementrapportages, continuïteit, traceerbaarheid, informatiebeveiliging en duurzaamheid. Alle inschrijvers dienen onvoorwaardelijk aan deze eisen te voldoen. De aanbestedende dienst is van oordeel dat inschrijvers zich hierdoor niet wezenlijk op kwaliteit kunnen onderscheiden zonder af te wijken van de gestelde eisen. Aanbestedende dienst is voornemens de opdracht te gunnen aan de inschrijver die een geldige inschrijving heeft ingediend en de laagste totale inschrijfprijs heeft aangeboden. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze overeenkomst wordt gesteld op € 2.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Netherlands – Collection agency services – Inning Invordering Bezwaar en Beroep
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europeesopenbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht Een van de taken van de gemeente is handhaving op parkeren. De gemeente Breda voert deze handhaving in eigen beheer uit. Daarbij worden sinds 2019 scanauto’s ingezet. Hierbij worden naheffingsaanslagen uitgeschreven. Deze naheffingen dienen geïnd te worden. Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2024. Het betreft de volgende aantallen NHA’s: Nederlandse kentekens: 110.000 Belgische kentekens: 11.000 Duitse kentekens: 1.500 andere landen kentekens: 5.000 27.755 bezwaren per jaar 88 beroepszaken per jaar De indicatie van de verwachte aantallen is ontleend aan de huidige situatie. Benadrukt wordt dat de omvang een indicatie is waaraan geen rechten ontleend kunnen worden. De werkelijke omvang van de opdracht kan dus in positieve of negatieve zin afwijken van de genoemde indicatie. Een doelmatige periodieke rapportage van de uitgevoerde activiteiten behoort eveneens tot de scope. De gemeente verwacht van de te contracteren partij dat ingespeeld wordt op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving. Deze partij communiceert bijvoorbeeld proactief wanneer invordering in meerdere/nieuwe landen mogelijk wordt. De te contracteren partij verstuurt de NHA’s, waarbij de vormgeving in samenwerking met de gemeente tot stand komt, o.a. dat op de uitgeschreven NHA’s verwezen naar de uitvoerende partij voor de bezwaarmogelijkheden, dit dient in tekst en d.m.v. een QR duidelijk te worden. De gemeente zorgt ervoor dat op haar website verwezen wordt naar de bezwaarmogelijkheden bij opdrachtnemer. De gemeente is op zoek naar een partij die een snelle en efficiënte afhandeling van de invorderingsdossiers en bezwarencases kan borgen, waarbij klantvriendelijkheid hoog in het vaandel staat. Wetende dat niemand ‘blij’ wordt van een naheffing, is juist bij de klantcontacten een klantvriendelijke en waar nodig de-escalerende benadering voor de gemeente van belang. De gemeente Breda is momenteel bezig met het opstellen van een wielklembeleid. Momenteel is de gemeente bezig met de eerste onderzoekende fase. Het is mogelijk dat tijdens het contract of net voor het vastleggen van het contract meer informatie beschikbaar is over het invoeren van het wielklembeleid. title: Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

description: The core of the delivery is FoUI guidance as described below. Oslo municipality also requests an option for other services. The R&D guides have the main assignment of mobilising businesses and Oslo ́s own entities for more research-supported R&D. The R&D guides discuss project ideas and possibilities with companies or the public sector and can connect R&D needs with relevant researchers. The FoUI guideline mobilises to regional, national and international schemes, as well as for preliminary projects and the subsidy scheme SmartOslo. Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De hierbij gebruikte procedure is het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem uit de Aanbestedingswet 2012. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Voor deze aanbesteding volgt Defensie de Europese aanbestedingsprocedure 'Dynamisch aankoopsysteem', conform de Aanbestedingswet. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. Kort samengevat Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot het DAS houdt geen opdracht in; Het MatlogCo plaats een nadere uitvraag; Deelnemer schrijft in; Het MatlogCo beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige Inschrijving. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem Bij de publicatie in maart 2023 had het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS) een initiële looptijd van 48 maanden. Echter, aangezien deze DAS een voortzetting is van de vorige DAS met het negometrix nummer 210681, resteert er nu nog een looptijd van 35 maanden. Het is belangrijk op te merken dat de Aanbestedende Dienst de looptijd één keer kan verlengen, met een periode van 48 maanden. Het staat de Aanbestedende dienst vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd producten en/of kwalificaties toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de Aanbestedende dienst waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Instellen van een tijdelijke DAS t.b.v. inhuur extern personeel
description: Door Hoogheemraadschap De Stichtse Rijnlanden (HDSR) wordt een tijdelijke DAS ingesteld. Voor de uitvoering van de DAS wordt het digitale platform van www.flextender.nl ingezet. Via deze website kunnen partijen zich aanmelden voor de DAS. Flextender controleert nieuwe aanmeldingen op de daarvoor gestelde eisen, waaronder akkoord inschrijfvoorwaarden FLX 2026, AWVODI-2018 en verklaring UEA. Alle nadere inhuuruitvragen van HDSR worden op de website van Flextender gepubliceerd. Onderhavige DAS gaat in vanaf publicatie van onderhavige aankondiging (april 2026) en loopt tot uiterlijk 1 mei 2027. HDSR bereidt op dit moment voor een nieuwe Europese aanbesteding voor de lange termijn omtrent inhuur van derden. De inhuren uit onderhavige DAS gaan per eerst mogelijke verlenging over naar de nieuwe contractant zodra deze overeenkomst is ingegaan. Alle inhuren die per 1 mei 2027 nog via Flextender lopen, gaan per die datum over naar de nieuwe contractant. Gemiddeld zet HDSR 75 inhuuruitvragen per jaar uit. Aan dit aantal kunnen volledig geen rechten ontleend worden. We stellen deze DAS in met inachtneming van alle andere raamovereenkomsten van HDSR. De scope van deze overeenkomsten blijft ongewijzigd ongeacht het instellen van deze DAS.

Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Doelstelling Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De KM beoogt met het DAS op een eenvoudige wijze, snel de behoefte aan kennis en capaciteit met goed en gekwalificeerd personeel op te vullen. Wij willen daarom een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe laten. Engineering Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Werktuigbouwkundige Electrotechnicus Scheepbouwkundige System Engineer Maintenance Engineer ILS-engineer Engineer E en WTB 2. title: 69--CH-53E Containerized Flight Training Device (CFTD) Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) Pre-Solicitation Teleconference
description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. All prospective offerors are advised that solicitation N61340-17-R-0035 will remain unchanged at the conclusion of the teleconference, unless this solicitation is amended in writing. If an amendment is issued, normal procedures relating to the acknowledgement and receipt of any such amendment shall be applicable. In no event, will failure to attend the conference constitute grounds for a claim after award of the delivery order. Le service assure l'accueil des campeurs, la gestion des réservations, l'entretien des installations, l'encaissement des redevances et l'ensemble des prestations nécessaires au bon fonctionnement et entretien du camping. Le Concessionnaire aura notamment pour mission d’assurer : - L’amélioration continue des équipements et services du camping mis à disposition (sanitaires, accueil, aire de jeux et plateau sportif, point de restauration, distributeurs de boissons et snacking en dehors des ouvertures du point de restauration, services extérieurs comme la location de vélos électriques par exemple, des propositions d’activités en lien avec l’Adour et les berges …) - La gestion et l’exploitation du camping, caravaning, avec 70 emplacements minimum avec mobil’homes (dont 2 lodges) avec une montée en gamme des équipements existants. - Le classement aujourd’hui en trois étoiles doit être à minima maintenu voire amélioré en fonction de la proposition du délégataire - la modernisation des installations par la création d’une aire de camping-cars de 10 places minimum et le développement des services associés - la mise en oeuvre de la plantation de 50 arbres pour les emplacements non ombragés aujourd’hui, en coordination avec le service de la commune sur le choix des essences, les techniques de plantation et l’implantation des arbres - la promotion et la commercialisation des équipements sur des sites internet et plateformes de réservations d’hébergements touristiques et réseaux sociaux - l’entretien des ouvrages et bien matériels et immobiliers mis à disposition - l’accueil du public

title: Residential Reentry Services and Home Confinement Services located within the Hampton Roads, Virginia Metro Area to include the cities of Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Poquoson, and Williamsburg.
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes located within the Hampton Roads, Virginia Metro Area to include the cities of Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Poquoson, and Williamsburg. The geographical radius for Home Confinement is within 100 miles of facility. Both the RRC and the Home Confinement services shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work entitled, "Residential Reentry Center, March 2022 SOW�. Home Confinement services are specifically defined in chapter 10, Programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity type contract with firm fixed unit prices for all line items. The RRC requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 96 beds in which 86 beds will be designated for males and 10 beds designated for females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods The Home Confinement requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 75 placements to include both males and females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC and HC) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. The Requst for Proposal (RFP) (solicitation) will be available after October 1, 2026, it will be distributed solely through the Government Point of Entry website, www.sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of this solicitation (RFP) will be 60 days after the solicitation date. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted. Any questions regarding the pre-solicitation notice can be addressed to Rachel Brown at r16brown@bop.gov by 2:00PM MST on Friday, September 18, 2026.

title: Coburn Gore LPOE Art in Architecture Project
description: Document Added & Updated: 0332CG-AIA- Coburn Gore AIA Questions & Answers V2 Dated 09 September 2026 The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Art in Architecture Program commissions American artists (citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents or Permanent Workers of the United States) to create publicly scaled and permanently installed artworks for Federal buildings nationwide. GSA announces an opportunity for a Federal art commission in conjunction with the new construction of the Coburn Gore Land Port of Entry (LPOE) in Coburn, Maine. The new facility will strengthen supply chains, improve operational capabilities and facility infrastructure, spur economic growth, and bolster the country�s security. The project will provide a fully operational LPOE that coordinates with the tra?c ?ow and operations of the Canadian port of entry at Saint-Augustin-de-Woburn Quebec, Port of Entry. The project will provide a new port that allows Customs and Border Protection to more efficiently carry out its agency mission, their operations and interactions with the public. GSA allocates one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the estimated construction costs of new or modernized Federal facilities for art commissions. The art budget for this project is estimated to be between $275,000 to $400,000. One or more artists will be awarded a fixed-price contract for a commission. Artists who wish to be considered for this GSA art commission must submit application materials to GSA by the SAM Contract Opportunity�s Response Date. Artists may also elect to be considered for all future GSA art commissions by submitting application materials to GSA�s National Artist Registry (Registry). Instructions on how to submit application materials and join the Registry are available on the following Web site: https://www.gsa.gov/real-estate/design-and-construction/art-in-architecturefine-arts/art-in-architecture-program/art-in-architecture-national-artist-registry All artists who wish to be considered as candidates for a commission at the LPOE in Coburn Gore, ME must have their application materials submitted and received by GSA by 12:00 PM Eastern Time on 30 September 2026. Artists� submissions received after the deadline will not be considered for this project but will be eligible for consideration on future GSA commissions alongside the other artists on the Registry. Artists already on the Registry need not resubmit but may elect to update their information prior to the deadline. GSA evaluates artists based on the following criteria: the media, materials, content and style of the artist�s past work, along with the artist�s past performance and experience with commissions or projects similar to the one described in this synopsis. Shortlisted artists will be contacted and asked to submit additional information, including a statement that the artist can perform the work associated with the GSA commission within the identified budget. GSA will count the combined weight of all the selection criteria as significantly more important than price. At minimum, the scope of services for this commission will require collaboration with the lead designer selected for the land port of entry project; travel to the project site; development and presentation of preliminary and final concepts; fabrication of the artwork; participation in meetings and conservation reviews as necessary; delivery and installation of the artwork; professional documentation of, and detailed maintenance planning for the artwork at the project site. For informational purposes: Artists selected for the contract award must be Permanent Residents or Citizens of the United States of America. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of award. Instructions for creating an account and activating registration in SAM may be found at www.sam.gov. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to renew the registration in SAM on an annual basis for the duration of the project. In accordance with Executive Order (EO) 13934, agencies should prioritize the commission of works of art that portray historically significant Americans or events of American historical significance or illustrate the ideals upon which our Nation was founded. Inquiries concerning the project should be directed to the following email address: Molly.Lewis@gsa.gov and reference the synopsis number in the subject line.

title: Residential Reentry Services and Home Confinement Services within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island.
description: Request for Proposal (RFP) - 15BRRC26R00000009 Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services and Home Confinement (HC) services for male and female offenders located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which are located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 8 beds (8 males and 0 females) and an estimated maximum 20 beds facility in which 18 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 3 placements and an estimated maximum 8 placements to include both male and female. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC26R00000009 will be available on or about August 3, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the General Services Administration's Federal Business Opportunities website at https://SAM.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of this solicitation (RFP) will be after 60 days around September 30, 2026. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted.
